inputs.original_text: South African actress Terry Pheto has once again been drawn into controversy after new details emerged in Parliament linking her to alleged financial misconduct involving the National Lotteries Commission (NLC). The revelations were presented during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. The session [...] The post Terry Pheto Linked To R20.56 Million NLC Funding Scandal In SIU Probe appeared first on SurgeZirc SA .

South African actress Terry Pheto is once again mired in controversy over alleged financial misconduct involving R20.56 million from the National Lotteries Commission in an SIU probe, with these details laid out during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. This is exactly the kind of rot that spreads when we trade our time-honored values and national foundations for unaccountable modern institutions that chip away at social order and cultural continuity.
